parameters.query:
SELECT
    dl.id_customer,
    pc.company,
    pc.email,
    dl.reference_article,
    p.produit,
    p.ean,
    SUM(dl.quantite_declaree) AS total_quantite,
    p.compensation_ht AS compensation_unitaire_ht,
    SUM(dl.quantite_declaree) * p.compensation_ht AS total_compensation_ht,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dl.id_declaration) AS nb_declarations
FROM declaration_lignes dl
LEFT JOIN prestashop_customers pc ON pc.id_customer = dl.id_customer
LEFT JOIN promotions_dji p ON p.reference_article = dl.reference_article
GROUP BY
    dl.id_customer,
    pc.company,
    pc.email,
    dl.reference_article,
    p.produit,
    p.ean,
    p.compensation_ht
ORDER BY dl.id_customer, dl.reference_article;
